reviewNotes: Separate GPT-6 AI editorial review of 40 original B1/B2 adjective exercises: checked complete German sentences, all four choices, inflected forms, unique answers, distinct contexts and bilingual feedback. Distinguished umfangreich (amount) from umfassend (coverage), überwiegend from ausschließlich, and used neutral taub and tödlich contexts. No inherited examples copied. Independent human linguistic, CEFR, rights and publication review pending.
